body: 第二天经过护士站时，坂口看见弘子一个人坐在交班记录前。她手边放着一杯已经凉掉的咖啡，眼下有一点浅浅的疲色。
「昨天那台患者怎么样了？」
弘子回答：
「醒得很顺利。今天早上还特地跟我道歉。」
「她为什么要道歉？那又不是她的错。」
「我也这么告诉她了。」
「昨天你处理得很好。患者失控的时候，你一下就把场面稳住了。本庄也没被你骂到抬不起头。」
「她又不是故意的。萌恵只是……有时候会忘记，自己知道的东西，患者并不知道。」
「你昨天还在手术结束以后教她？所以才这么困？」
「一点点而已。」
「你的‘一点点’通常不太可信。」
「昨天她留下来，把整套术前流程重新走了一遍。包括器械车应该停在哪里、患者醒着的时候什么东西不要进入她的视野，还有怎么回答患者的问题。」
「到几点？」
「杉村。」
弘子移开视线：
「十一点多。」
「可是她学会了。」
她的声音带着疲惫，却明显有一点满足。
「新人犯错不可怕。最怕的是没人告诉她为什么错。」
「你很喜欢照顾后辈。患者也是。昨天那种场面，换个人可能先想着怎么把手术按时做下去。你先想到的是她有多害怕。」
「因为躺在台上的人，只有那一个。」
「我们一天可能进很多次手术室。可是对她来说，也许一辈子就只有这一次。」
她揉了揉有些发酸的眼角。
「所以……累一点也没关系。这些女孩子能慢慢变成可靠的护士，患者也能平平安安回家……」
弘子露出一个疲倦却温柔的笑容。
「我觉得都是值得的。」
弘子怔了一下。
「被依赖可不一定全是好事。」
她嘴上这样说，表情却明显柔和了一点。
「那至少把咖啡换成热的。」
弘子低头看了一眼杯子：
「……什么时候凉的？」
「这就是我说的问题。」
「又来了。」
她嘴上抱怨着，却没有拒绝坂口从她手里拿走那杯冷咖啡。

When passing the nurse station the next day, Sakaguchi saw Hiroko sitting alone in front of the shift record. She had a cup of cold coffee in her hand, and she looked a little tired.
"How was the patient yesterday?"
Hiroko replied: "I woke up smoothly. You even apologized to me this morning."
"Why is she apologizing? It's not her fault."
"That's what I told her."
"Yesterday you handled it very well. When the patient lost control, you stabilized the situation immediately. I was not scolded by you until I couldn't hold my head up."
"She didn't mean it. Menghui just... sometimes forgets that the patients don't know what she knows."
Sakaguchi asked: "You taught her after the operation yesterday? Is that why she is so sleepy?"
"Just a little bit."
"Your 'little' is usually not trustworthy."

"Yesterday she stayed and went through the entire preoperative process again. Including where the equipment cart should be parked, what should not enter her field of vision when the patient is awake, and how to answer the patient's question
"What time?"
"...It's not too late."
"Sugimura."
Hiroko looked away: "It's past eleven o'clock."
"But she learned."
Her voice was tired, but obviously a little satisfied.
"It's not scary for a newbie to make mistakes. The biggest fear is that no one will tell her why she made a mistake."

"You like to take care of your children. So do the patients. In a scene like yesterday, someone else might have first thought about how to carry out the operation on time. The first thing you thought about was how scared she was."
"Because there is only one person lying on the operating table."
"We may go into the operating room many times a day. But for her, it may only be this once in her life."
She rubbed the corners of her sore eyes.
"So...it doesn't matter if you are a little tired. These girls can gradually become reliable nurses, and the patients can go home safely..."
Hiroko gave a tired but gentle smile.
"I think it's all worth it."
Hongzi was startled.
"Being dependent is not always a good thing."
As she said this, her expression softened significantly.
"Then at least change the coffee to hot."
Hiroko glanced down at the cup: "...When did it get cold?"
"That's the problem I'm talking about."
"Here we go again."
She complained, but did not refuse Sakaguchi to take the cup of cold coffee from her hand.
